caption: The drawing depicts a round, decorative plate with a symmetrical design and earthy color tones. The outer rim features a repeating pattern of green and yellow segments bordered by dark, almost black accents and a scalloped edge inside the plate. The inner portion of the plate has a reddish-brown background, and the central area contains a circular, green motif with concentric circles. Radiating from the center are three leaf-like shapes in muted green and beige, spaced evenly around the center and connected by a thin, brown, triangular outline that encloses the central motif. The overall design is geometric and symmetrical. The artist's name, "FRITZ BOEHMER," is printed in black text at the bottom right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Deep Dish
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
